name: siakam
caption:
PICK 27 🎮🏀 The Raptors' best draft steal ever?

• 2016 draft: Pascal Siakam goes 27th
• 2019: Most Improved Player, 16.9 PPG
• Finals Game 1 vs the Warriors: 32 points on 14-of-17, Raptors win 118-109
• A ring and 2 All-NBA teams in Toronto

Best Raptors draft pick ever? 👇

beats.head: PASCAL SIAKAM
beats.name: SIAKAM
beats.vo: The twenty sixteen draft. With pick twenty-seven, the Raptors take a raw forward from Cameroon: Pascal Siakam.

beats.head: LEVEL UP
beats.name: SIAKAM
beats.vo: Three years later: Most Improved Player, sixteen point nine a game.

beats.head: FINALS GAME 1
beats.vo: Finals Game one against the Warriors: thirty-two points, on fourteen of seventeen. Raptors win.

beats.head: CHAMPION
beats.name: SIAKAM
beats.vo: A ring, and two All-NBA teams... from pick twenty-seven.
